nodes.label: Expert B: ID Prefix System
nodes.rationale: Standardizes ID formats (e.g., LN-, SG-, EQ-) to ensure referential integrity across the synthetic knowledge graph.

nodes.label: Expert B: Relation Type Enums
nodes.rationale: Defines 9 relation types (material_flow, drive, hydraulic_supply, etc.) with specific causality and lag properties for graph traversal.

nodes.label: Causality vs Co-occurrence Rule
nodes.rationale: Defines the logic for distinguishing causal relationships from co-occurrence to prevent false cause candidates.

nodes.label: QC-CAUSE-01
nodes.rationale: Validation rule ensuring cause candidates are supported by abnormal observations.

nodes.label: QC-CAUSE-02
nodes.rationale: Validation rule rejecting co_occurrence relations as cause candidates.

nodes.label: Relation Table Schema
nodes.rationale: SQLite schema for storing equipment relations with indexing for N-hop traversal.

nodes.label: N-hop Recursive CTE
nodes.rationale: Recursive SQL query for upstream/downstream equipment discovery with a 3-hop limit.

nodes.label: 10-Step Scenario Generation
nodes.rationale: Structural implementation of time-flow reproduction to prevent future information leakage.

nodes.label: Field Visibility Classification
nodes.rationale: 3-tier visibility (pre_action, post_action, ground_truth) to enforce data isolation.

nodes.label: Canary Token Leak Detection
nodes.rationale: Dynamic leak detection using unique tokens in ground truth sentences.

nodes.label: Data Scale Option 3 (Recommended)
nodes.rationale: Balanced scale (72 events, 42 sealed items) to ensure statistical significance within inspection capacity.

nodes.label: Event Prototype (PT)
nodes.rationale: Grouping key for events to prevent leakage by ensuring similar scenarios stay in the same split.
